acceptance_signals: A 2024.4 row containing four tile values of 9 serializes to exactly 83 09 00 00 00 00 00 00.
The aligned record deserializes back to the same four tile values.
The reader consumes all eight bytes and no more.
Repeat, verbatim and sentinel runs each align their absolute end position to four bytes; multiple runs and unaligned record starts remain correct.
Writer, reader and child-count paths agree for mixed runs, chunk boundaries, empty layers and a following record; 2024.2 and 2024.3 remain unpadded.
All UInt32 tile values, including 0xffffffff, remain actual data; terminal pairs are separate records.
Zero-length, oversized runs and overflowing dimensions fail before the next record is consumed.
